_machineReadable: 43 of the 128 badges carry statModifiers, hook, rollable, blockers and engineStatGap, merged from the Crucible 2026-08-21. The other 85 are prose only and still need the machine-readable half. content/ owns badges (COMBAT-DESIGN.md §8: HoBaT authored its own; the 238-row Hell-TCG library is a reference, not a port).

_cut.name: Backstabber
_cut.reason: Built on flanking, which does not exist (Law 11 — positional advantage is adjacency, zones of control, knockback, Reach and terrain). Cut 2026-08-21 rather than reshaped.

_cut.name: The Unnamed
_cut.payload: `op: set` — Accuracy 100, Crit 3, Luck 0. Nothing modifies them again.
_cut.reason: Used `op: set` to fix Accuracy/Crit/Luck so nothing could modify them. Stat overrides and floors are banned (FUNCTIONS.md) — modify a stat, never replace or clamp it. It was the only user of the mechanic. Cut 2026-08-21.
